title: Reed’s ω–Δ–χ conjecture
statement: Reed’s ω–Δ–χ conjecture · formulated around 1995 and published in 1998. Every graph satisfies \(\chi\le\lceil(\Delta+1+\omega)/2\rceil\).

counterexample.description: A connected simple graph on at most 18 vertices not colorable with ceil((Δ+1+ω)/2) colors. A complete check computes Δ, the exact clique number, and bounded colorability.
